protocol.publication_scope: Separate exploratory appendix; no changes to Round28/30 confirmation scores or failure records.
protocol.selection: First eligible seed-zero reference (>4000 kernels) in frozen order per original GPU, separately for new Objaverse and GSO; original outcomes were already observed.
protocol.initialization: Default, tenth and adaptive share the calibration-edited/recoloured reference; direct continues the independently fitted budget-limited initializer. Initial fits used 5000 updates.
protocol.objective: Inherited source-UV fitting target; all four routes use identical uniform sampling from the fixed pool, rather than the original priority sampler.
protocol.controller: For predicted d=grad(L)^T delta<0, s=min(1,0.1*L/(-d+1e-30)); otherwise s=0.1. Scale all group learning rates and restore them before the scheduler. Moments are not reset or rescaled.
protocol.controller_limit: First-order prediction before constraints and geodesic tracing; no actual-loss acceptance check, field/render error bound or convergence guarantee.
protocol.evaluation: Only the prescribed final update; decoded evaluation with five PBR views and 65536 surface queries. Primary metric is mean-view render PSNR.
protocol.timing: All arms calculate the proposal diagnostic; recorded wall times include this instrumentation and do not establish controller overhead or speedup.
protocol.scale_encoding: For each adaptive record, scale_below_one contains every [one-based update, scale] with scale<1. All other updates have scale=1. Original full trace hashes are retained.
protocol.original_protocol_note: The frozen September protocol initially excluded the pilot from v1. The completed pilot was later admitted only as an explicitly exploratory appendix.
protocol.reproducibility: This export and CPU command recompute endpoint and scale summaries; they do not expose a complete training replay or redistribute original models, queries or full traces. Initializer, hook, model and trace hashes identify the original experiment artifacts; hashes alone do not make those artifacts available.
